Alex Freeman.note: Freeman's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Alex Freeman.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Alex Zendejas.summary: Álex Zendejas is a United States right winger from América who gives the national team left-footed service, box arrivals, and Liga MX sharpness.
Alex Zendejas.note: Watch Zendejas for delivering the ball without needing much space. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Alex Zendejas.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Antonee Robinson.note: Robinson is defined by recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Antonee Robinson.noteZh: 他靠防线暴露后的回追速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Auston Trusty.note: Trusty is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Auston Trusty.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Brenden Aaronson.note: Aaronson stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Brenden Aaronson.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Chris Brady.note: Brady stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Chris Brady.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Chris Richards.note: Richards stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Chris Richards.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Christian Pulisic.note: Pulisic's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Christian Pulisic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Cristian Roldan.note: Roldan is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Cristian Roldan.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Folarin Balogun.note: Balogun's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Folarin Balogun.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Giovanni Reyna.note: Reyna's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Giovanni Reyna.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Haji Wright.note: Wright stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Haji Wright.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Joe Scally.note: Watch Scally for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Joe Scally.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Malik Tillman.note: Tillman is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Malik Tillman.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Mark McKenzie.summary: Mark McKenzie is a United States centre-back from Toulouse who gives the national team recovery defending, clean passing, and aerial control.
Mark McKenzie.note: Watch McKenzie for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Mark McKenzie.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Matt Freese.note: Freese stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Matt Freese.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Matt Turner.note: Turner's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He waits for the strike before committing.
Matt Turner.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。

Max Arfsten.note: Arfsten stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Max Arfsten.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Miles Robinson.note: Robinson stands out for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Miles Robinson.noteZh: 他的突出特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Ricardo Pepi.note: Pepi's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ricardo Pepi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Sebastian Berhalter.note: Berhalter's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Sebastian Berhalter.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Sergino Dest.note: Dest stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Sergino Dest.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Tim Ream.note: Ream is defined by calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Tim Ream.noteZh: 他靠高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Timothy Weah.note: Weah's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Timothy Weah.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Tyler Adams.note: Adams is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Tyler Adams.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Weston McKennie.note: Watch McKennie for using strength without slowing the next action. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Weston McKennie.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。
